update_instructions: Manual evidence update: edit real_estate_data.json in deantil/three-lens-market-dashboard. For each field retain its source URL, actual observation timestamp, status and concise finding. Only use verified after obtaining the matching primary document (county parcel/bill, current HOA governing documents and written rental/dues confirmation, comparable leases, insurance/inspection and lender approval). Reconcile conflicts; update numeric scenarios to match evidence. Record reviewed_at only after reviewing sources. Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_real_estate.py and commit/push reviewed changes to main; Streamlit redeploys from main. Reload page to load the deployed JSON. No automatic listing scraper or broker outreach is configured. Link availability alone never refreshes a fact or verifies eligibility. Verified evidence older than 7 days is blocked automatically. Official record routes: https://www.lansingmi.gov/city-assessor and https://myplace.cuyahogacounty.gov/ . Michigan transfer guidance: https://www.michigan.gov/documents/treasury/TransferOwnershipGuidelines_423898_7.pdf .
